Finding: Thirteen of seventeen navigation items accept a legacy role after permission checks fail.
Required disposition: Remove role fallback and define declarative route permissions.

Finding: Nine /time/* deep links are not exact navigation records and therefore bypass the shared AppShell route gate.
Evidence: src/app/router.tsx and exact path lookup in AppShell
Required disposition: Add a central route policy map; retain page and RPC checks as defense in depth.

Finding: Admin automatically passes Time permission helpers.
Required disposition: Use effective permissions only; preserve explicit safety rules separately.

Finding: Action Center, Directory, Schedule, Sites, and Users & Access contain fixed-role authorization fallbacks.
Required disposition: Replace action authority with effective permissions and test grants plus denies.

Finding: admin.users.manage accepts a legacy Admin-role fallback.
Required disposition: Require the effective permission and its MFA requirement.

Finding: Notification processing accepts four fixed operations roles or a permission.
Required disposition: Use effective permission authority only and preserve MFA.

Finding: Twenty-nine live functions contain role references without an effective-permission helper.
Required disposition: Classify each function; convert business authorization or document non-authorizing helper use.

Finding: Thirty-nine of fifty live RLS policies contain role references without an effective-permission check.
Required disposition: Convert sensitive reads and all writes to permission-aware policies or RPC-only boundaries.

Finding: Four protected public RPCs have explicit anon execute grants despite internal permission checks.
Required disposition: Revoke anon execute and retain authenticated grants where required.

Finding: Private functions retain PUBLIC execute grants even though anon/authenticated lack private schema usage.
Evidence: Live function grants and schema privilege snapshot
Required disposition: Revoke PUBLIC; explicitly grant service_role or required internal owners.

Finding: MFA requirement metadata exists on permissions but several client and Worker paths still infer MFA from role.
Evidence: Permission catalog plus AccountSecurity and Worker role checks
Required disposition: Enforce MFA based on the effective permission being exercised.

Finding: Some Users & Access actions require Admin role even if a custom role has the required permission; other actions grant all Admins regardless of a deny override.
Required disposition: Use effective permissions and keep last-Admin protection as a separate invariant.

Finding: Current high-impact grants have not yet been explicitly approved as the intended future matrix.
Required disposition: Obtain business approval before changing enforcement or role grants.

Finding: One live function name public.rls_auto_enable is not defined in repository migrations; renamed and overloaded functions make static counts non-authoritative.
Required disposition: Document or migrate the platform function and always compare against a live snapshot.

Finding: Role labels and employee-versus-operations presentation choices are mixed into the same role-reference population as authorization checks.
Required disposition: Keep presentation-only logic separate and prohibit it from granting data or actions.

Finding: The system lacks one end-to-end matrix proving revoke and grant behavior across navigation, direct routes, buttons, Worker, RPC, and RLS.
Required disposition: Add positive and negative permission-contract tests before rollout.
